title: The eye trace is red in beat 4 and the shaded beat: the brightest region is not the emitter
text: Run on animatic 04's frames the eye-trace check reports 462 frames over 3 % of the width: 270 of the 300 frames of beat 4 (worst 30 %) and 192 of the shaded world's frames 1382-1619 (worst 67 %). In beat 4 at frame 630 the brightest unmasked region is at about (1109, 508), on Clawd, not the frame's glow at (1000, 140); the same check on the committed code's frames 700 and 780 (this run's 'before' stills, old keys and old blocking) read 19.7 % and 19.6 %, so it was red before the pose changed. The restaging helped elsewhere: arrival at frame 90 went from 2.5 % to 0.5 %, everything-at-once at 300 from 1.9 % to 0.4 %, cant-build at 525 from 3.8 % to 0.9 %, home-settle at 1700 from 5.0 % to 0.6 % and at 1800 from 4.0 % to 0.4 %, because the props no longer sit over the lit blocks. This is the question p007 asks (what the light pushes, per beat); the colour-continuity check fails on the same frames (630 drawn but unreadable). Row 8.6 (2026-10-19), after D100: the check now asks each story point's target and masks the kit's and gadget's pale roles only where their props are drawn. The beat-4 failure was the measurement: with the old mask the lamp (frames 700-880) read 18-27 % off, with the new one 0.1 % (0.0 % against the frame interior); retargeting alone, old mask, left 7-16 %. Animatic 04 now reads 232 of 1196 measured frames over 3 % (was 462 of 1638): beat 4 has 2 (928-929, 3.5 %); the shaded world's frames 1382-1519 and 1648-1649 (140) fail because the animatic's glow sits on the gates while the story points name the join and the frame interior; 1860-1949 (90) read 7.6-7.9 % because the held picture's light rests in the structure and the frame interior is dark; 510 frames name targets the animatic does not draw (the crayon's colour, the drawn line, the leaf, the piece's lines, the running bead) and are refused by name. The colour check's unreadable-hue frames fell from 630 to 149. With the screenplay's eye field read first (sp-2.2 the trio, sp-2.3 the human), animatic 04 reads 422 of 1198 measured frames over and s01 233 of 416 with the layer: the flood frames fail on both renders because the lamp's white core is the brightest thing and sits 110-170 px from the cast; the staging, not the probe, has to move the light onto what the script says the eye follows.
before: eye-trace: 462 of 1638 frames over 3 %, beat 4 and the shaded world (worst 30 % and 67 %)
after: eye-trace (D100): 232 of 1196 measured frames over 3 % (beat 4: 2); 510 frames refused by name; 120 skipped as nothing readable; the rest are the story points and the animatic disagreeing (see text)
